compilation.basis: 2f_view.png: calibrated from top '15000' dimension ticks (x=427->0m,x=1813->15m) and left '8000' dimension ticks (y=328->8m north,y=1067->0m south). Outer wall faces confirmed at x=427/1813(ish) and y=331/1071 by direct gray-pixel profiling. North half (y=331-600) is ONE open conference hall: the thin non-filled vertical line near x=718 has no gray fill and no wall-thickness pixel support, unlike all real partitions (which are gray-filled or clearly double-line to the exterior), so it is treated as a non-wall (ceiling/beam) mark, not a room divider; the two round tables share one wide double-door opening into the corridor (matches North wall single continuous window band per side, confirmed against the 1950/3600/1889/1891/3600/1950 north dimension chain which places a solid/door zone at the centre, not a second partition). South half (y=800-1071) has 4 offices divided by 3 real partitions located by direct pixel inspection at x=727,1115,1456, each with its own corridor door. Window spans on north/south walls from cumulative dimension chains anchored at x=427. West/East single-window openings (F2) matched to West_view.png/East_view.png upper row (3400/1200/3400 offset pattern) at the corridor's mid-depth.
